Created by Taiga (GabrielTaiga). Apache License 2.0: free to use, modify and distribute, as long as the credits to the author are kept (NOTICE file).

Steam game page: NativeGameLink for Steam (MIT, David Miranda).
Identification: Redump/No-Intro (libretro-database) · Artwork: SteamGridDB and libretro-thumbnails · Info: IGDB, Steam, Wikipedia/Wikidata (CC BY-SA) and PCGamingWiki · Achievements: RetroAchievements, Steam, Epic, GOG, Xbox, Exophase, RPCS3, Vita3K, shadPS4 and ports.

help.title: Help
help.lead: Quick answers to the most common questions.
help.q.ach: Why doesn’t my game show achievements?
help.a.ach: Check that you connected the needed accounts in Accounts: RetroAchievements for emulator games, PlayStation for PlayStation ports and Epic, Xbox or GOG for games from those stores. Some games simply have no achievements.
help.q.port: My ported game has no achievements or they don’t update
help.a.port: Ports almost never write an achievements file, so the game can’t report when you unlock one. Most of the time Taiga Launcher fetches the original game’s achievement list from a database: they show up, but don’t unlock by themselves while you play. You can mark the ones you earned by hand on the game’s achievements screen in Taiga Launcher.
help.q.notSteam: Why didn’t a game go to Steam?
help.a.notSteam: Almost always the platform’s emulator is missing (or its core in RetroArch). Set up or download the emulator in Emulators and the game goes to Steam by itself.
help.q.retroarch: How do I use only RetroArch?
help.a.retroarch: In Emulators, turn on "Use RetroArch for retro platforms" on the RetroArch card. NES, SNES, Mega Drive, N64, PC Engine and others then open in it whenever it has the platform’s core. On the Steam version of RetroArch, cores are enabled under DLC.
help.q.pc: How do I add PC games?
help.a.pc: Use "Choose installed games" to tick, from a list, the games Taiga Launcher found on your PC. Another option is the shortcuts folder (in Settings): every shortcut you put in it becomes a game in Steam.
help.a.comments: Yes. Everyone who has the same game in Taiga Launcher sees what you write, with your Steam name and picture. You need to connect your Steam account to comment, and you can delete your comments at any time.
help.q.stores: How do I install Epic and Xbox games through Steam?
help.a.stores: Connect the store account in Accounts and turn on "Show games not installed" in Settings. The games show up in Steam with an Install button on each game page.
help.q.remove: How do I remove a game from Steam or Taiga Launcher?
help.a.remove: In the Collection, open the game and use its options to remove it from Steam or hide it. To remove everything at once, use "Remove all from Steam" in Settings.
